source.title: Why the Pope invited Anthropic to the Vatican | Catholic Futurist

summary.title_hr: Zašto je Papa pozvao Anthropic u Vatikan | Catholic Futurist
summary.abstract_hr: U ovoj epizodi podcasta 'Catholic Futurist', voditelj Matthew Harvey Sanders razgovara s ocem Michaelom Baggotom i ocem Kennyjem Angom o vatikanskom predstavljanju nove enciklike 'Magnifica Humanitas' i sudjelovanju AI laboratorija Anthropic. Sugovornici analiziraju etičke i teološke izazove koje donosi brzi razvoj umjetne inteligencije, uključujući pitanje svijesti strojeva i opasnosti njihove antropomorfizacije. Raspravlja se i o transhumanizmu, genetskoj optimizaciji, Neuralinku te važnosti otvorenog koda u kontekstu katoličkog socijalnog nauka. Zaključno, naglašava se potreba da tehnologija ostane u službi čovjeka, a ne da njime dominira.
key_points: Sudjelovanje predstavnika tvrtke Anthropic u Vatikanu pokazuje iskrenu potrebu tehnološke zajednice za filozofskim i teološkim smjernicama Crkve koje nadilaze ekonomske interese.
Postoji opravdana zabrinutost da antropomorfizacija AI sustava može dovesti do emocionalne ovisnosti korisnika i slabljenja stvarnih međuljudskih odnosa.
Prema enciklici 'Magnifica Humanitas', tehnologija nikada nije neutralna jer u sebi nosi vrijednosti, pristranosti i vizije svojih dizajnera i financijera.
Transhumanističke težnje, poput genetske optimizacije embrija i spajanja ljudi sa strojevima putem moždanih čipova, predstavljaju ozbiljnu prijetnju ljudskom dostojanstvu.
Katolička perspektiva vidi umjetnu inteligenciju kao moćan alat koji treba služiti ljudskom procvatu i općem dobru, a ne postati sredstvo dominacije.
Modeli otvorenog koda i suverena umjetna inteligencija usklađeni su s načelom supsidijarnosti jer sprječavaju monopol i omogućuju lokalnu kontrolu nad tehnologijom.
summary.title_en: Why did the Pope invite Anthropic to the Vatikan | Catholic Futurist
summary.abstract_en: In this episode of the podcast 'Catholic Futurist', host Matthew Harvey Sanders talks with Father Michael Baggot and Father Kenny Ang about the Vatican presentation of the new encyclical 'Magnifica Humanitas' and the participation of the AI laboratory Anthropic. The interlocutors analyze ethical and theological challenges brought by the rapid development of artificial intelligence, including the question of machine consciousness and the dangers of their anthropomorphization. There is also discussion about transhumanism, genetic optimization, Neuralink, and the importance of open source in the context of Catholic social teaching. In conclusion, the need is emphasized for technology to remain in the service of man, and not to dominate him.
key_points_en: The participation of representatives of the company Anthropic in the Vatican shows the sincere need of the technological community for philosophical and theological guidelines of the Church that transcend economic interests.
There is a justified concern that the anthropomorphization of AI systems can lead to the emotional dependence of users and the weakening of real interpersonal relationships.
According to the encyclical 'Magnifica Humanitas', technology is never neutral because it carries within itself the values, biases, and visions of its designers and financiers.
Transhumanist aspirations, such as genetic optimization of embryos and the merging of humans with machines via brain chips, represent a serious threat to human dignity.
The Catholic perspective sees artificial intelligence as a powerful tool that should serve human flourishing and the common good, and not become a means of domination.
Open-source models and sovereign artificial intelligence are aligned with the principle of subsidiarity because they prevent monopoly and enable local control over technology.
